seo.title: Savvy Yute Management | Artist Management, Lagos and Accra
seo.description: Savvy Yute Management is an artist management and music services company working between Lagos and Accra: A&R, distribution, publishing admin, release paperwork, rollout and PR for artists, labels and brands.
seo.keywords: artist management Lagos, artist management Accra, music distribution Nigeria, music PR Ghana, split sheets, release rollout, Hip Hop Cabin

hero.headline: Artist management, Lagos to Accra
hero.intro: We manage artists and run releases for artists, labels and brands, from the paperwork to the playlists. Through Hip Hop Cabin, we cover the culture too.

services.title: Artist management
services.text: Career direction, team building and day-to-day decisions. We work with signed and independent acts, often on short-term deals built around one release or project.

services.title: A&R
services.text: Sound direction, collaborators and song selection, so every release is the right one.

services.title: Distribution and publishing admin
services.text: Delivery, metadata and PRO registration handled properly, so royalties reach the people who earned them.

services.title: Release paperwork
services.text: Split sheets, producer agreements and featured-artist agreements, cleared before release day.

services.title: Rollout, PR and marketing
services.text: DSP and editorial pitching, press releases, paid social and listening sessions across Nigeria and Ghana.

services.title: Events and brand partnerships
services.text: Event project management in Lagos and Accra, from planning and ticketing to the night itself, and artist partnerships for brands that want the right voice.

partner.text: Tribe Boyz Entertainment is the Lagos hip-hop label that houses Tribe Boyz, Napoleon TBFI and Maxijonez. It's a separate business. Savvy Yute partners with it on artist management and releases.
